name: AP_INTERFACE_REJECTIONS
description: AP_INTERFACE_REJECTIONS stores information about invoice data from the AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE and  AP_INVOICE_LINES_INTERFACE tables which could not be processed by Payables Open Interface Import.  . If you use Oracle e-Commerce Gateway, you can pass information from this  table to your suppliers by submitting the Payables Open Interface Outbound Advice for rejected data. . You can purge data in this table by using the Payables Open Interface Purge.

columns.name: PARENT_TABLE
columns.description: Reference to table in which the rejection occurred (AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE or AP_INVOICE_LINES_INTERFACE)

columns.name: REJECTION_MESSAGE
columns.description: Reason for rejection of a record.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to invoice or invoice line identifier which was rejected (INVOICE_ID or INVOICE_LINE_ID)

columns.name: REJECT_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Code that provides the reason for rejection of a record.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.
